parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags that are added to the specified SMC resource. This parameter is valid only if you do not set `TagKey.N`. Valid values:

*   true: removes all tags that are added to the specified SMC resource. If no tags are added to the specified SMC resource, no operation is performed.
*   false: does not remove tags that are added to the specified SMC resource.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of N SMC resources. SMC resources include migration sources and jobs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the SMC resource. Valid values:

*   sourceserver: migration source.
*   replicationjob: migration job.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The key of tag N that is added to the SMC resource. Tag keys are case-sensitive. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc untag-resources --resource-type sourceserver --all false --resource-id s-bp12tueadp5ndleg0000 --tag-key smc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 's-bp12tueadp5ndleg0000' --TagKey.1 smc --ResourceType sourceserver
